ecommerce_tax_scheme.name: EU VAT / Swedish VAT + OSS/IOSS/import rules
ecommerce_tax_scheme.note: Validate OSS/IOSS, customs, WEEE/battery producer responsibility, GPSR and category-specific obligations per seller/SKU.

research_principle: Sweden is a mature ecommerce and source-oracle market. Large installed bases must be penalized when local specialist execution is already deep. Prioritize transient lifecycle or emerging-model cohorts where catalogue/service growth demonstrably lags installed-base/problem demand.
